verdict.rationale: A GPU can plausibly be used headless for compute automation, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents headless or CI operation of the RTX 5070 Ti. The CUDA toolkit, NGC containers, and general deployment statements are developer building blocks, not an evidenced headless/CI capability of this card.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
